podcasts.title: 383 - Live From New York, it's....... Tonebenders?
podcasts.transcript: New York City is a big market for audio post production and it has it's own quirks that make it unique. We gathered some of the city's top sound crafts people for a roundtable talk about how they broke into the business in this city, how they worked with mentors and how they see things evolving into the future. This conversation was recorded live in front of an enthusiastic, sold out crowd at Sound Lounge in the Flatiron District of Manhattan. Big Thanks to Lidia Tamplenizza, David Forshee, Megan Chase, Daniel Timmons and Steve “Major” Giammaria for sharing all their experience and knowledge.
